products.name: Solar panel 550W (mono)
products.description: Monocrystalline 550 W panel; 8 to 12 of them power a typical home system through the day.

products.name: Hybrid inverter 6kW
products.description: 6 kW hybrid inverter with a built-in MPPT charger; runs a whole apartment, including one AC unit, from panels and batteries.

products.name: Hybrid inverter 3.6kW
products.description: 3.6 kW hybrid inverter for smaller homes: lights, fridge, internet and a washing machine.

products.name: Lithium battery 5kWh (LiFePO4)
products.description: 48 V 5 kWh LiFePO4 battery; keeps a home running through the evening power cuts. Stackable.

products.name: Wall battery 2.5kWh (LiFePO4)
products.description: Slim 2.5 kWh wall battery for small systems and offices; keeps internet, lights and a laptop on.

products.name: Roof mounting kit (4 panels)
products.description: Aluminium rails, clamps and bolts for four panels on a flat concrete roof.

products.name: PV cable 6 mm² (50 m roll)
products.description: UV-resistant red and black solar cable, 50 m; connects the panels on the roof to the inverter.

products.name: DC breaker & surge protection box
products.description: Pre-wired box with DC breakers and a surge protector between the panels and the inverter.

products.name: Portable power station 1kWh
products.description: 1 kWh battery with sockets and a USB charger; runs a router, lights and a laptop through a power cut. No installation.

products.name: Solar water pump kit 1HP
products.description: Pump, controller and float switch that run straight from 4 to 6 panels; waters crops and fills tanks in summer.
